lead: Neymar is a widely followed Brazilian association football player, born on 5 February 1992 in Mogi das Cruzes.
As of 2026, he is 34 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has represented Santos F.C. and has been recognised with Samba Gold and South American Footballer of the Year.
Below you will find a verified overview of Neymar: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Neymar — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Neymar was born on 5 February 1992 in Mogi das Cruzes, and holds Brazilian nationality. He was given the name Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior at birth and is publicly known as Neymar.
Public records name his father, Neymar da Silva Santos. He is a sibling of Rafaella Santos.
He is recorded as speaking Brazilian Portuguese and Portuguese.

sections.heading: Neymar — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists association football player as his main occupation.
On the team sheet, Neymar has been associated with Santos F.C. (from 2025). He plays as a wing half.
He has taken part in 2012 Summer Olympics, 2014 FIFA World Cup, football at the 2016 Summer Olympics, 2018 FIFA World Cup and Ice Bucket Challenge.
